name: Tianneng Power International Limited
summary: Tianneng Power International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of lead-acid batteries and its accessories for the light electric vehicle market in the People's Republic of China. It operates through two segments, Manufacturing Business and Trading. The company offers bicycle (tricycle) batteries, four-wheeler batteries, tubular batteries, and starter and start-stop batteries for automobiles; lead-acid motive batteries; and lead-carbon energy storage systems and backup batteries.
